title: Celebrating '21
description:
August 15
August 15: Dansby Swanson homers for a third straight game, Freddie Freeman and Austin Riley go back-to-back, and the Braves complete a sweep at Nationals Park 6-5 to take sole possession of first place for the first time all season.

title: Celebrating '95
description: August 3: The Braves carry a 3-1 lead into the eighth, watch the Phillies score three, then answer with two in the bottom of the ninth for a 5-4 walk-off that pushes Atlanta's NL East lead to 9 1/2 games.

title: BravesVision Top 10 2026
description:
Braves at Rockies, May 1
Down 6-1 after six at Coors Field, the Braves storm back. Mauricio Dubon clears the bases with a triple in a four-run eighth and Michael Harris II adds a two-run homer in the ninth for an 8-6 win in Walt Weiss's return to Colorado.

title: Behind the Braves
description: Ronald Acuna Jr. returns from the World Baseball Classic. Raisel Iglesias and Robert Suarez talk about the work they're putting in to bolster the backend of the bullpen. Go fishing with Dylan Lee and Ozzie Albies.

title: BravesVision Top 10 2026
description:
Braves at Dodgers, May 9
Spencer Strider earned the win with six scoreless innings, while Ozzie Albies and Matt Olson each drove in two runs to lead the Braves to a 7-2 win over the Dodgers, on the day that former manager Bobby Cox passed away.

title: Riding With the Braves
description:
Walt Weiss
New manager Walt Weiss joins Braves Radio Network's Ben Ingram to talk about his career playing, coaching and what his mindset is heading into the 2026 season.

title: Celebrating '95
description: September 24: The final home game of the regular season at Atlanta-Fulton County Stadium. A crowd of 45,461 watches the division champions hold off Montreal 5-4 for the Braves' 88th win of the year.

title: Celebrating '95
description: October 14: Steve Avery throws six scoreless innings and series MVP Mike Devereaux caps a five-run seventh with a three-run homer as the Braves shut out Cincinnati 6-0, complete the sweep and win their third pennant in five years.

title: Behind the Braves
description:
Veterans Day Edition
Braves Historian Sam Wallace joins the show to honor the Braves players who served in the United States military. From World War I through the Vietnam War, Wallace shares remarkable stories of service and sacrifice while showcasing historical artifacts from some of the franchise's military veterans.

title: BravesVision Top 10 2026
description:
Cubs at Braves, May 13
Drake Baldwin's 402-foot drive off Shota Imanaga starts it, then Mike Yastrzemski's pinch-hit double and Mauricio Dubon's two-run homer break an eighth-inning tie. Atlanta beats the Cubs 4-1 to become the first club to 30 wins.

description:
Phillies at Braves, April 26
Chris Sale wins the 150th game of his career, allowing one hit over six innings with nine strikeouts; Matt Olson's three-run homer off Aaron Nola opens the scoring as Atlanta beats Philadelphia 6-2 and becomes the first club to 20 wins.

description: C.J. Nitkowski hosts the Hall of Fame induction speeches by Braves greats Hank Aaron, Phil Neikro, Bobby Cox, Eddie Mathews, Fred McGriff and Andruw Jones.

Red Sox at Braves, May 15
Drake Baldwin and Michael Harris II homer off rookie Connelly Early, and Spencer Strider allows one run over 5 1/3 innings. After Boston ties it late, Mike Yastrzemski ends it with a walk-off double in the 10th for a 3-2 Braves win.

description:
Mauricio Dubon

title: Celebrating '95
description: April 26: Baseball returns after the strike. Greg Maddux opens on the mound, Fred McGriff homers twice in a 17-hit barrage, and rookie Chipper Jones makes his first Opening Day start as the Braves rout the Giants 12-5 at Fulton County Stadium.

title: Celebrating '21
description:
September 30
September 30: Champagne at Truist Park. Ian Anderson deals, Jorge Soler and Austin Riley homer, and the Braves finish off a sweep of the Phillies 5-3 to clinch a fourth straight NL East title in front of 38,235.
